agents.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim (color-system Agent 1 protocol)

Twist C: Heading font weight shift +300 across all headings (clamped at 900 for h3). Syne replaced with Figtree — rounded humanist sans selected for Claymorphism concept match: circular letterforms and warm geometry echo tactile inflated geometry.

Twist C: All easing curves replaced with spring/elastic variants. Primary: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1). Elastic: cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Keyframes include 60-70% overshoot frames. Added blobMorph, clayInflate, squishPress, floatY keyframes for Claymorphism.
Twist B: Container paddingInline increased from 22px to 34px — wider breathing room allows clay card clusters to float rather than crowd.
Twist A: Section vertical padding expanded from 80px to 128px — deep architectural breathing room for inflated clay sections to read as sculptural objects.

Twist D: Clay squish physics. Hover = scale(0.97) + shadow reduction. Active = scale(0.93) + scaleX(1.03) lateral spread. All easing: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1). Button shadows tinted to element color. Focus rings spring-animated outlineOffset.
Twist B: Letter spacing increased from normal to 0.08em — wider tracking creates deliberate, tactile cadence for navigation text complementing rounded Claymorphism geometry.

Full Claymorphism rewrite. concept_by_image.md: 6 sections covering tactile inflated geometry, clay-like materiality, haptic depth through colored tinted shadows, spring-based elastic motion, soft sculptural surfaces, rounded moldable forms. concept_by_video.md: motion brief with 7 sections including 3 video placements (hero-ambient.mp4 clay press 10s, clay-craft.mp4 6s, spring-field.mp4 5s).
